notes.title: SEX Police 🔞🚨 is coming this Saturday!
notes.notes:
[h3]Step into the gritty world of crime, corruption, and forbidden temptation! In SEX Police, you’re more than just an officer – you’re the one called to handle the city’s most dangerous criminals, from a cartel queen to an arms-dealing madam. 

But your choices are everything: will you walk the line as an enforcer of justice, or let yourself slip into the shadows as a “bad cop” who plays by his own rules?

Uncover backstories, hidden motives, and desires as you interrogate suspects and navigate a world where every choice impacts your reputation and relationships. Meet characters like your loyal partner, a complex girlfriend, and notorious criminals – each with their own secrets to discover and their own ways of influencing your path.

[u]Wishlist SEX Police now to experience this unique blend of crime drama, 18+ scenes, and thrilling choices. [/u]

[b]Are you ready to clean up the streets or get pulled into the underworld?[/b]
[/h3]
